name: General Engineering
summary: An English engineering BSc at Lyngby: build a foundation in maths and science, work on design-build projects and choose from Living Systems, Advanced Materials, Cyber Systems and Future Energy.
description: The first year combines mathematics, programming, physics, chemistry and biotechnology and introduces at least two specialisations. Choose your direction by year two. The final year offers electives, exchange or a company project, followed by a sixth-semester bachelor project.

structure.teachingStyle: Lectures, student-directed learning and design-build group projects; teams grow from three towards ten members.
structure.placement: Company projects are optional and need company and DTU supervisors; this is not a guaranteed placement or compulsory BEng internship.
structure.studyAbroad: Semester 5 can be spent abroad, at DTU, at another Danish university or taking a partner online course.
structure.flexibility: Choose a specialisation by year two; the third year has electives and a final bachelor project.
